sections.title: Full text
paragraphs: An episode in the revolutionary war in China, 1911-the revolutionary women's army attacks Nanking* *This work by T. Miyano continues the tradition of war prints issued at the time of the Sino-Japanese War (1894- 1895) and the Russo-Japanese War (1905), but those were woodblock prints. Here, the traditional technique has been abandoned, and western-style lithography adopted in its place. Perhaps intended for export to China.
